questions.q: Of what was this the history?
questions.a: This was the history of the descendants of Aaron and Moses.

questions.q: What were the names of Aaron’s sons?
questions.a: The names of Aaron’s sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

questions.q: Why did Nadab and Abihu fall dead before Yahweh?
questions.a: Nadab and Abihu fell dead before Yahweh when they offered unacceptable fire to him.

questions.q: Which of Aaron’s sons served as priests with Aaron?
questions.a: Eleazar and Ithamar served with their father Aaron as priests.

questions.q: Which tribe did Yahweh say was to help Aaron serve as priest?
questions.a: The tribe of Levi was to help Aaron.

questions.q: What were the duties of the tribe of Levi?
questions.a: They were to perform the duties on behalf of Aaron and the whole community, care for all furnishings, and help the tribes with the tabernacle service.

questions.q: Whom did Yahweh give to help Aaron and his sons?
questions.a: Yahweh gave the Levites to Aaron and his sons to serve as priests for the people of Israel.

questions.q: Whom did Yahweh set apart for himself?
questions.a: Yahweh set apart for himself the Levites and all the firstborn in Israel, both people and animals.

questions.q: When did God set apart all the firstborn of Israel?
questions.a: He set apart for himself all the firstborn in Israel on the day that he attacked all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.

questions.q: Whom did Yahweh command Moses to count in the tribe of Levi?
questions.a: Yahweh commanded Moses to count every male in Levi who was one month old and older.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Levi?
questions.a: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.q: Where were the clans of the Gershonites to camp?
questions.a: The clans of the Gershonites were to camp on the west side of the tabernacle.

questions.q: Who was to lead the clans of the descendants of the Gershonites?
questions.a: Eliasaph the son of Lael was to lead the clans of the descendants of the Gershonites.

questions.q: Who was to care for the tabernacle curtains, the tent, the tent covering, the entrance curtain, the courtyard hangings, the courtyard entrance curtain, and the courtyard, ropes, and all that was in the tent of meeting?
questions.a: The clans of the Gershonites who camped on the west side of the tabernacle were to care for the tabernacle coverings, curtain, and ropes.

questions.q: What were the clans from Kohath who camped on the south side of the tabernacle do?
questions.a: They were to take care of the sanctuary, the sanctuary curtain, and everything in the sanctuary.

questions.q: Who was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest to supervise?
questions.a: He was to supervise the men who led the Levites and the men who cared for the sanctuary.

questions.q: Who was to lead the clans of Merari who camped on the north side of the tabernacle?
questions.a: Zuriel son of Abihail was to lead the clans of Merari.

questions.q: What were the clans from Merari who camped on the north side of the tabernacle do?
questions.a: They were to care for the boards of the tabernacle, the crossbars, posts, bases, all of the hardware, and everything that went with them.

questions.q: What were Moses and Aaron and sons who were camped on the east of the tabernacle do?
questions.a: They were to do the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the people of Israel.

questions.q: What was to happen to any foreigner who approached the sanctuary?
questions.a: Any foreigner who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

questions.q: Whom did Moses and Aaron count?
questions.a: Moses and Aaron counted all the males in the clans of Levi who were one month old and older.

questions.q: Whom did Moses take for Yahweh instead of the firstborn of Israel and instead of their livestock?
questions.a: Moses took the Levites and their livestock instead of Israel’s firstborn men and livestock.

questions.q: Then whom did Moses count?
questions.a: Moses counted all the firstborn males of Israel by name, aged one month old and older.

questions.q: To whom did all the Levites belong?
questions.a: The Levites belonged to Yahweh.

questions.q: How many sanctuary shekels did Moses collect per firstborn to buy back each of the 273 firstborn people of Israel who exceeded the number of the Levites?
questions.a: Moses collected 5 shekels each to buy back each of the 273 firstborn people of Israel who exceeded the number of the Levites.

questions.q: To whom did Moses give the money to buy back the first born of the people of Israel?
questions.a: He gave the money to Aaron and his sons as Yahweh had commanded him.

questions.q: How much did Moses do of what he was told to do by Yahweh’s word?
questions.a: Moses did everything he was told to do by Yahweh’s word.

commentary.text: The sons of Aaron, The Levites taken instead of the first-born.
The Levites numbered by their families, Their duties.

Verses 1–13 There was much work belonging to the priests' office, and there were now only Aaron and his two sons to do it; God appoints the Levites to attend them. Those whom God finds work for, he will find help for. The Levites were taken instead of the first-born. When He that made us, saves us, as the first-born of Israel were saved, we are laid under further obligations to serve him faithfully. God's right to us by redemption, confirms the right he has to us by creation.

The Levites were in three classes, according to the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari; and these were subdivided into families. The posterity of Moses were not at all honoured or privileged, but stood upon the level with other Levites; thus it was plain, that Moses did not seek the advancement of his own family, or to secure any honours to it. The tribe of Levi was by much the least of all the tribes. God's chosen are but a little flock in comparison with the world.

The number of the first-born, and that of the Levites, came near to each other. Known unto God are all his works beforehand; there is an exact proportion between them, and so it will appear, when they are compared together. The small number of first-born, over and above the number of the Levites, were to be redeemed, and the redemption-money given to Aaron. The church is called the church of the first-born, which is redeemed, not as they were, with silver and gold; but, being devoted by sin to the justice of God, is ransomed with the precious blood of the Son of God. All men are the Lord's by creation, and all true christians are his by redemption. Each should know his own post and duty; nor can any service required by such a Master be rightly accounted mean or hard.
